name: demo-showcase-toolkit
description: Create Demo Match client showcases by copying selected demos while preserving the source library.

interface.shortDescription: Describe a showcase and copy your selected demos.
interface.longDescription: Create event, booth and audience showcases by describing the page and selecting demos. Copies records, hosted videos and captions through Demo Match, preserves the original library, and verifies publication. Requires an authorized Demo Match account. PDF imports and external players need per-showcase verification.
